subject: vsim: extend platform-cache gate to L3C, RMW CONTROL restore, describe key
description: In vsim_andesim: (1) simulator.hpp l2c_present()/l2c_base() accept _NDS_L3C_CACHE_SIZE_KB/_NDS_L3C_REG_BASE as fallback; (2) resume_driver.hpp restore_l2c CONTROL becomes read-merge-write of policy bits [7:0] so RTL RAM-timing [13:8] is preserved (unit test first in tests/hybrid/resume_driver.test.cpp); (3) main.cpp describe_engine emits l2c_reg_base when present. Rebuild engines via ./build_vsim.sh (container). Commit (behavioral).
activeForm: Extending vsim platform-cache transport to ax66 L3C
